== Summary ==
Identified: [[Logan Pietig]] and [[Garrett Larson]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
The Friday-night team tournament: two young players face [[Garrett Larson]] (right, bearded) and his partner.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-08-11
* '''Camera date:''' 2023-08-11 19:12 (from the original file name)
* '''Identification:''' [[Garrett Larson]] (right): his GEMP and Slack handle is deadbody; the poster tagged deadbody playing at 21:33 the same evening in the same clothes ([[:File:2023 World Championship Scott Lingrell vs Garrett Larson.jpg]]), and deadbody wrote in the channel that evening that the other three players in his team match had a combined age less than his. The other players are not named.
